topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't believe I had no clue. Every day, I'd see them, the ordinary couple next door, always polite, always cordial. Yet, beneath the veneer of simplicity, they were hiding an opulent life. I heard it from a source I trust. Their lavish vacations, the investments, the properties abroad—it's all too much to fathom. I keep wondering, how did they manage it all, right under my nose? The worse part, they never flaunted it, never let on. Now, I can't shake the unease, the feeling that everything I thought I knew about them, and perhaps about myself, is just a surface story. What else don't I know?
